title: Aoyagi Toya — To The Costuming Team!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Lunch break
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Things were so busy at reception today.
More books than usual did get returned...)
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Did your shift at the library just end?
You're always hard at work.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and thank you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You look pretty tired... Was it really busy today or something?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, we had quite a few visitors today.
I suppose now that the arts festival is over, everybody's coming back to return the books they'd borrowed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Fortunately, we were able to work as a team and get every one back to its shelf.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All those books coming back is proof that every class was doing what they could for the arts festival...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Every presentation was really polished, so I guess that checks out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That includes your class's interpretive dance, Aoyagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really liked the part when you guys all stopped on a dime at the same time. Also, congratulations on your podium finish.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you.
I'm also glad that we were able to produce such good results.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not only that, this festival ended up being a good experience for me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I helped make the costumes, but I really wasn't sure if I'd be able to at first since I didn't know anything about sewing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I was able to contribute to the team because everyone else was nice enough to teach me how.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even for our dance, we were initially all over the place and struggled to make it to the end of our routine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But after many conversations and a lot of practice, we slowly figured out how to move as a single unit.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again, I'm happy that my class was able to achieve some good results for this festival.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I'm even happier about how we were able to work together to create something for everyone in the school to see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, learning to do something new wasn't easy, but both sewing and our dance made for very valuable experiences.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're so honest, Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I am?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
But I also went through a similar experience...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wasn't sure what was gonna happen after everyone asked me to be the director...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But I'm really glad they did...
Directing our film ended up being a great experience.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's nice to hear that we were both able to gain something from this. Also, I forgot to congratulate you on winning the judge's prize...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Your class's film was very good.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You think so? That's great to hear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First of all, the stunts felt so dynamic because of the camera work. I couldn't help but feel drawn into the action.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I don't really know much about movies, but I'm guessing there were a few clever tricks involved...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As for the screenplay, although I was startled by the peculiar world you'd chosen at first...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: After the apocalypse, a cook wanders the wastes fighting against evil while delivering food to those in need... I was impressed at how the story showcased his integrity and kindness.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? O-Oh, thanks...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was also a bit surprised when I found out that you'd written such a screenplay, Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, I... So...
I had some help with that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see... That would certainly explain the setting. Whoever you asked must be quite imaginative.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you were ultimately tasked with turning it into a single, coherent story, no? It was very well put together, and that attention to detail felt very you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: R-Really...? Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not to mention...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Even when he's praising others, he's really honest...)
